# ToolsVerse App — Complete Index & API Specification

> ToolsVerse App (https://toolsverseapp.com) provides 103+ client-side web tools.

## Architectural Security
- Zero server backend: All computations run within the client's WebAssembly sandbox.
- Compliance: GDPR, HIPAA, FERPA compliant by architecture.
